# CTest names excluded from `run_tests: full` (linux-x64) in
# .github/workflows/build.yml. One test per line, followed by the reason.
# Only tests that need something a CI runner can never have belong here:
# the owned retail game files (assets/original, never on a runner) or a GPU.
# Everything else must pass on CI.

# Retail models (assets/original/kv6)
aos_class_catalog_tests          character body models
aos_entity_catalog_tests         every entity model must load
aos_model_quality_tests          soldier body model
aos_particle_system_tests        grave model fixture
aos_weapon_models_tests          tool and weapon models
aos_disguise_models_tests        disguise models
aos_ads_sight_pin_tests          weapon models (semi.kv6)
aos_inventory_tests              weapon world fit uses the retail LMG model
# Retail sounds (assets/original/wav, ogg)
aos_entity_attachment_tests      sticky and riot-shield cues
aos_jetpack_audio_tests          jetpack cues
aos_weapon_audio_map_tests       explosion samples
aos_server_audio_catalog_tests   the original sound tree
# Retail maps, textures, fonts and UI images
aos_map_catalog_tests            shipped map set
aos_map_atmosphere_tests         shipped skydome set
aos_skydome_scroll_tests         skydome gradient textures
aos_texture_quality_tests        particle atlases in each texture root
aos_weapon_catalog_tests         generated weapon asset paths
aos_text_tests                   retail Spades and UI fonts
aos_frontend_tests               main menu images
aos_quick_play_frontend_tests    Quick Play images
aos_ugc_editor_menu_tests        UGC editor images
aos_sdl_window_tests             retail cursor image
